Awards & Honors

2026 Jiangsu Province Graduate Research and Practice Innovation Program

Congratulations to Huang Zhiyu on successfully being awarded the 2026 Jiangsu Province Graduate Research and Practice Innovation Program!

July 13, 2026

Outstanding Graduate of the School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Class of 2026

Group member Wang Wenhao was named an Outstanding Graduate of the School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Class of 2026.

July 7, 2026

Innovation Capability Enhancement Program Funding

Congratulations to Chu Zhiming on receiving the 2026 Southeast University Doctoral Student Innovation Capability Enhancement Program funding!

December 18, 2025

2024 Open Source Security Award Program Outstanding Student

Congratulations to Huo Anqi, Li Ruoqian, Zhang Zihao, and Zhang Hanyu on receiving the Outstanding Student Award (Second Prize) in the 2024 Open Source Security Award Program!

November 5, 2025

2025 Jiangsu Province Cyber Security Society Teaching Award

Congratulations to Li Guyue on receiving the 2025 Jiangsu Province Cyber Security Society Teaching Award (First Prize)!

November 1, 2025

President's Scholarship

Congratulations to Xiao Qingjiang on receiving the President's Scholarship!

October 18, 2025

Merit Graduate Student

Congratulations to Chu Zhiming on being named a Merit Graduate Student.

October 18, 2025

National Scholarship

Congratulations to Xiao Qingjiang, Huo Anqi, and Chen Jiaping on receiving the National Scholarship.

October 18, 2025

Global Top 2% Top Scientists List 2025

Congratulations to Li Guyue on being selected for the “Global Top 2% Top Scientists List 2025”

September 16, 2025

”College Student Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition" Nomination Award

At the finals of the 2025 China Cyber Security Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition, the project “FrameGuard—Human Activity Recognition and Privacy Protection System Based on BFI Wireless Sensing,” supervised by Li Guyue of the School of Cyber Science and Engineering at Southeast University and completed by Wang Tiantian, Yang Chaoyue, Liu Lu, and Liu Luogeng, won the Nomination Award in the "College Student Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition"

September 16, 2025

Best Paper Honorable Mention at IEEE CNS 2025, a Top Cyber Security Conference

The paper "Collusion-Driven Impersonation Attack on Channel-Resistant RF Fingerprinting" by Li Guyue and undergraduate student Xu Zhou, on RF fingerprinting impersonation attacks, received the Best Paper Honorable Mention at IEEE CNS 2025, a top cyber security conference!

September 8, 2025

Excellence Award in the 18th National College Student Information Security Competition

Congratulations to Xu Zhou and other students on receiving the Excellence Award in the 18th National College Student Information Security Competition

August 15, 2025

First Prize in the 18th National College Student Information Security Competition

Congratulations to Wang Tiantian and other students on receiving the Most Innovative and Entrepreneurial Value Award in the 18th National College Student Information Security Competition.

August 15, 2025

Outstanding Advisor in the 18th National College Student Information Security Competition

Congratulations to Li Guyue on receiving the Outstanding Advisor Award in the 18th National College Student Information Security Competition.

August 15, 2025

Achievement Selected as One of the Top Ten Scientific and Technological Advances in Jiangsu Province's Industry Sectors for 2024

Congratulations to Li Guyue on the achievement “Development and Industrialization of IoT Security Technology Based on Quantum Keys” being selected as one of the Top Ten Scientific and Technological Advances in Jiangsu Province's Industry Sectors for 2024!

June 13, 2025

Outstanding Graduate of the School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Class of 2025

Group members Sun Haixi and Li Haoyu were namedOutstanding Graduate of the School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Class of 2025。

June 13, 2025

 Accepted by IEEE Internet of Things Journal

Congratulations to group member Huo Anqi and colleagues on their work"Enhancing Wireless Communication Security With Variable Bloom Filter-Based Physical-Layer Secure Transmission"being accepted by IEEE Internet of Things Journal

May 1, 2025

 Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security

Works by Xiao Qingjiang and others from the research group"Optimal Subcarrier Allocation Scheme for Physical-Layer Key Generation in an OFDMA Network"has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security.

May 1, 2025

 Accepted by IEEE Network

Works by Zhou Yajie and others from the research group"Endogenous Security Techniques for Safeguarding Next-Generation Spectrum Usage at the Physical Layer"has been accepted by IEEE Network

July 7, 2026

Accepted by Computer Networks

Works by Chu Zhiming and others from the research group"Defeating CSI obfuscation mechanisms: A study on unauthorized Wi-Fi Sensing in wireless sensor network"has been accepted by Computer Networks.

March 8, 2025

Graduate Student Zhishan Award

Congratulations to our group members Li Haoyu and Sun Haixi for being nominated for the 2024 Graduate Student Zhishan Award.

July 7, 2026

National Scholarship

Congratulations to our group members Wang Wenhao and Tang Honghai for being nominated for the National Scholarship. To date, our group has accumulated 9 nominations for the National Scholarship.

November 15, 2024

Outstanding Graduate Student

Congratulations to Hou Yujie, Luo Hongyi, Sun Yilun, and Ma Yiyun for being named Outstanding Graduate Students of Southeast University

January 21, 2024

Top Ten Mentor Nomination and College Outstanding Mentor

Dr. Li Guyue received the title of “Top Ten Mentor Nomination and College Outstanding Mentor” in the 14th “My Favorite Graduate Mentor” selection activity.

April 2, 2024

National Scholarship

Congratulations to our group members Li Haoyu and Sun Haixi for being nominated for the National Scholarship. To date, our group has accumulated 7 nominations for the National Scholarship.

20 SRTP Projects

20 SRTP projects, including 3 national innovation projects and 3 provincial innovation projects

Congratulations to Chen You, Chen Ying, Zheng Liwen, and Qi Tianyi for winning the First Prize in the 14th National College Student Information Security Competition

Congratulations to Jin Jiaqi, Wang Wenhao, Wu Zihan, and Ding Xiaoya for winning the Second Prize in the 14th National College Student Information Security Competition

First Prize of Jiangsu Province Outstanding Graduation Design

Congratulations to Chen You for his thesis "Research on Secret Key Generation Methods for Wireless Channels in Multi-User Massive MIMO Systems" being awarded the First Prize of Jiangsu Province Outstanding Graduation Design

Third Prize in the 7th National Cryptography Technology Competition

Congratulations to Zhao Jinrong, Hou Yujie, and Yang Lilin for winning the Third Prize in the 2022 7th National Cryptography Technology Competition. Entry title: A Lightweight Over-the-Air Secure Transmission System Based on One-Time Pad.

“Third Prize in the ”Electromagnetic Environment Big Data Innovation and Practice Competition"

Congratulations to Hu Aiqun,Li Guyue, Yang Ti, Zhang Xinwei, Yang Haiyu, Yu Jiabao, Xing Yuexiu, Jiang Yu, and Peng Linning for winning the Third Prize in the “Electromagnetic Environment Big Data Innovation and Practice Competition” with their entry “Precise Perception and Active Defense of Electromagnetic Devices”
